notes:

- Added automatic Microsoft-signed Edge (--app) / system browser fallback whenever CoopOverlay.exe is blocked by OS security policy, stopping repeated Windows Security popups on F10/Multiplayer clicks
- Includes all v1.0.22 fixes: saved-game reload Host pawn/camera/HUD/region rebind, saved-game lobby auto-region selection & legacy .coop.json auto-heal, Steam Cloud sidecar fallback, and AI town hijack guard
